answer: Each consensus pulse serializes one registration thread: identity k burns k scarce settlement credits, enforced by a permanent global issuance counter. The alias sparrow gets the same price as any other name. Splitting wallets cannot split the counter; deleting identities cannot rewind it. Pre-aging aliases means paying upfront. A farm’s first n identities cost at least n(n+1)/2 credits, and its next registration costs at least n+1.
